claims.claim: Mooncake can be used as the PD KV transfer backend between Prefill and Decode workers.
claims.notes: Request-scoped peer transfer, not persistent HiCache storage.

claims.claim: Mooncake Store can provide HiCache L3 storage for reusable KV pages.
claims.notes: L3 backend role is distinct from PD transfer.

claims.claim: Mooncake Master manages logical space allocation and eviction, while Store and SGLang exchange payloads directly.
claims.notes: Metadata service may be optional or embedded/P2P.

claims.claim: The global multimodal embedding cache stores encoder embeddings and is independently enabled from encoder transfer backend selection.
claims.locator: Global multimodal embedding cache with Mooncake
claims.notes: This is not language-model KV cache.

claims.claim: HiCache direct-linker prefetch commits a page only after all attention TP ranks confirm complete KV; failed reads can fall back to recomputation.
claims.notes: Per-rank private GPU slots and completion policy matter.

claims.claim: The hit path latency includes lookup, fetch and promotion costs.
claims.notes: A hit helps only when fetch/promotion is cheaper than recomputation.
